headline: The imprimitivity decomposition from Pass1079 survives, but its orbital-pairing conclusion does not. Exact ordered-pair classification shows 12 self-paired orbitals and 20 non-self-paired orbitals arranged in 10 transpose pairs. Pass1082 supplies the complete 32-class intersection tensor and the independent 22-class GSp fusion.
scope: Pass1079 remains authoritative for imprimitivity and the seven-orbital frame-graph union. Pass1082 supersedes only its orbital-pairing assertion.
